vars.SUB: Three weeks to contract on one street. Past ninety days on the next. Same price band — the median hides it.

vars.TITLE: Choosing who lists it
vars.LINES:
Two attorneys. One house.
One agent, somehow.
[[gap]]
Usually decided fast —
a friend, or whoever called first.
Then every conversation runs
through the other side's person.
[[gap]]
Ask first: who is [[circle]]neutral?[[/circle]]
vars.NOTE: -> same information, both sides. nothing said privately.

vars.HEADLINE: The Difference Is In The Contract
vars.DECK: Allowance lines, change orders, completion dates that move, warranty terms — and whose interests the on-site representative is actually looking after.

vars.TITLE: Before anything can be listed
vars.LINES:
The family is ready to sell.
Nobody can sign yet.
[[gap]]
Title asks for letters.
No one explained the gap,
so the house sits empty
and the questions pile up.
[[gap]]
First question: [[circle]]authority.[[/circle]]
vars.NOTE: -> general overview only. your attorney confirms the timeline.

vars.HEADLINE:
Twenty Minutes
[[i]]in January[[/i]]
vars.SUB: The same drive is a different drive in weather — and the honest trade was never about miles.
That is where nine out of ten buyers decide whether your house exists. The shoot day outworks the staging.

vars.HEADLINE: Panic Is A Planning Failure
vars.DECK: Short appraisal. Financing gone ten days out. Something structural at inspection. Each one already has a response — decided while everything was calm.
